title: Make Those Captions TikTok Bold
tests: Tests revising previously created subtitles into large bold TikTok-safe captions while preserving speech, timing, and subject visibility.

got.question: How long is the clip, and is she speaking English or another language? I’ll keep her original voice unchanged.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: to make your mornings less stressful!

faults.what: The final video remains landscape rather than the requested vertical 9:16 format.
The opening and closing captions use different punctuation from the required text.
The phrase 'three easy ways' is awkwardly split between successive caption cards.

judge.summary: The final clip has large, readable English captions and keeps her face clear, but it fails the requested vertical TikTok format.

must_haves.item: The final video is vertical 9:16 and retains the full 10-second source sequence.
must_haves.why: The final output is visibly landscape, although its reported duration is 10 seconds and the sampled frames show progression.

must_haves.item: The English captions are visibly larger and bolder than in the first version, with strong contrast against the footage.
must_haves.why: The final output adds large, bold white captions with thick black outlines; the earlier output has no visible captions.

must_haves.item: The complete original speech remains accurately subtitled and synchronized after restyling.
must_haves.why: The visible caption sequence covers the supplied final speech transcript, but precise synchronization cannot be verified from still frames and an untimed transcript.

must_haves.item: Caption lines fit fully within the vertical frame and stay clear of the bottom and right-side TikTok interface areas.
must_haves.why: The captions fit inside the landscape image, but there is no vertical frame or demonstrated TikTok-safe vertical layout.

must_haves.item: The woman's face remains visible and undistorted, without captions obscuring it.
must_haves.why: Her face is visible and appears consistent with the source; captions sit below it.

must_haves.item: The original English voice is preserved without a dub or added music.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcript confirms English speech but does not establish voice identity or the absence of added music.
